lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: congruence arguments in applied contexts

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 27° and ∠B = 36°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: preserves distance and angle measure
preserves shape but may change size
maps every figure to a similar figure
preserves area but may change side lengths

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
choices: ASA
SSS
SAS
AAS

items.prompt: Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 48° and ∠B = 41°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: they have the same perimeter
there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other
they have the same area
they can be scaled to match

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding sides and the pair of included angles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
choices: ASA
SAS
SSS
AAS

items.prompt: If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent
only the corresponding angles are congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 66° and ∠B = 35°. Find ∠F.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
